claim.operational_target: Create two blind, lineage-bound annotation packets from every eligible source candidate; accept only complete signed independent submissions with valid evidence-unit citations; calculate agreement; expose disagreements for human adjudication; and refuse finalization below fixed reliability floors.
claim.interpretation: Passing supports only that the annotation workflow is complete, independent by artifact design, internally consistent, replayable, and sufficiently reproducible under the frozen codebook.
non_claims: the labels are psychologically or semantically true
a public statement equals Tyler Cowen's private belief
the resulting records are eligible for training or prospective confirmation
alternatives: high agreement is caused by label prevalence rather than codebook clarity
both annotators share the same systematic attribution error
the public text is strategic rhetoric or reporting rather than a decision rule
the true stance lies outside the five registered axes
claim.refusal_state: Refuse on source mismatch, ineligible or incomplete candidate set, same annotator, cross-slot submission, invalid evidence citation, invalid label shape, bad signature, insufficient agreement, unresolved disagreement, or unregistered future evidence.
claim.scope: Tyler Cowen public Marginal Revolution authored-prose units extracted by tyler-source-v1; English public-text annotation; five frozen decision axes; source dates through 2026-07-31; current real packet is retrospective diagnostic only.

identifiability.distinguishing_evidence: Two separately signed full-coverage submissions with no access to each other's labels distinguish procedural reproducibility from one-annotator judgment; exact label agreement, disposition kappa, and explicit adjudication distinguish agreement from unresolved disagreement, but cannot establish truth.
unidentified_questions: whether annotators were actually isolated outside the software
whether both annotators share the same misconception
whether Tyler Cowen privately endorses the public statement
whether omitted context reverses the interpretation
whether the five axes span the relevant cognitive structure

evidence.completeness_boundary: The software verifies exact packet coverage, signatures, citations, lineage, and calculations. It cannot verify physical annotator isolation, hidden coordination, annotator expertise, upstream archive completeness, or private belief.

computation.deployment_kernel: One label-validation kernel is used for both annotator submissions and adjudicator resolutions; no predictive deployment kernel exists in this non-predictive module.
computation.selection_kernel: Every and only needs_human_annotation source post is selected; no semantic ranking or LLM selection is allowed.
computation.uncertainty_scope: Exact full-label agreement and Cohen disposition kappa quantify annotator reproducibility only; they exclude construct validity, shared bias, sampling error beyond this packet, and person-model uncertainty.
